dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, thin pale-grey margins provide high-contrast definitions against dark-grey feather centers on folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Dense pattern of transverse, semi-circular dark bars across the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp and linear boundary separates the unpatterned light-grey crown from the heavily barred nape and mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform, unpatterned crown color creates high contrast against the complex scalloped pattern of the dorsal plumage.
